messages:
sasha: Scheduled cron 'scheduled-bench/weekly' failed this morning on bench-14, CI is red. Model-refresh step passed but the benchmark suite stalled during 'kv-cache-eviction.test'. Can someone triage? @alex @ryan

eng-bot: automated report: job scheduled-bench/weekly #987 failed. exit_code=1. artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/bench/987/logs.tar.gz

alex: looking now. can you paste the tail of the log? or i'll grab from artifacts.

sasha: pasted tail below:
```
[03:11:58] running kv-cache-eviction.test
[03:12:02] WARN kv_cache: eviction loop took 1.2s (threshold 200ms)
[03:12:03] ERROR bench: test timeout after 30s
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"/usr/local/bin/bench_runner\", line 212, in <module>
    run_tests(tests)
  File \"/usr/local/bin/bench_runner\", line 143, in run_tests
    raise TestTimeout(\"kv-cache-eviction.test\")
TestTimeout: kv-cache-eviction.test
```

ryan: that WARN + timeout smells like disk IO stall or GC pause on that host. bench-14 had higher iowait yesterday during a compaction. ops team, any host-level alerts? @ops-bot

ops-bot: host bench-14 reported disk_pressure alerts at 03:10 UTC (node.disk.iowait > 70%). Alert window: 03:09-03:15. No recent kernel upgrades. See host metrics: https://internal.metrics/bench-14

maya: quick check — the model-refresh step writes shard manifests to /mnt/bench/cache. If the disk was under pressure, eviction tests could be slower. Can we rerun just the failed test on a healthy host?

alex: i triggered a rerun of the single test on bench-09 (less loaded). Command used: `ci rerun --job 987 --scope kv-cache-eviction.test --target bench-09`

eng-bot: rerun queued as job #988 on bench-09. logs will appear at s3://redwood-ci/bench/988/logs.tar.gz

ryan: if #988 passes we can mark bench-14 as flaky / transient. if it fails, we should bisect. I see a recent change that touched cache eviction algorithm: rev abc123 -> def456 in PR #4217. Sasha, did your nightly include that?

sasha: nightly includes PR #4217 rolled out on 2025-06-02. i'm worried the change interacts poorly under IO pressure. i can kick a git bisect on the bench harness if #988 fails.

maya: note: there is an existing flaky-tests list at infra/flaky_tests.txt. If #988 passes, add kv-cache-eviction.test with note: "time-based flaky under disk pressure" and set CI to retry 2x for this test.

eng-bot: #988 succeeded on bench-09 (exit_code=0). artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/bench/988/logs.tar.gz :tada:

alex: ok so transient. actions:
- add test to flaky list
- schedule a dedicated run on bench-14 after maintenance window to confirm
- add stronger iowait guard in CI for bench-14 (skip if node.disk.iowait > 50%)

sasha: will file the follow-ups. quick TODOs assigned to me:
- update infra/flaky_tests.txt (+commit message)
- open a small ops ticket to increase monitoring for bench hosts
- add a canary that runs eviction test on bench-09 nightly for next 3 days

ryan: quick note for bisect if needed later — start range: abc123..HEAD, use `git bisect run ./bench_harness --run kv-cache-eviction.test` and limit to 8 parallel commits to avoid noise.

maya: thanks all. i'm marking this resolved for now but leaving follow-ups in my board. :thumbsup:

sasha: thanks everyone, closing thread once commits and ticket are created.
